articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator mode-selective add-drop unit for on-chip mode-division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A broadband, low-crosstalk, mode-selective add-drop multiplexer using quasi phase-matching and staged coupling is presented. This ultra-compact device can be used to enable mode-division multiplexing for further increasing the aggregate bandwidth of on-chip optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Improved design of an InP-based microdisk laser heterogeneously integrated with SOI
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Microdisk lasers heterogeneously Integrated with SOI are promising sources for photonic Integrated circuits based on silicon. The microdisk lasers are only a few micrometers In size and they allow for wafer scale fabrication. We have demonstrated a new design of an electrically Injected microdisk laser bonded on SOI with a considerable Improvement of the performance. We observed threshold currents as low as 350 muA and output power up to 120 muW for a 7.5 mum microdisk diameter under continuous-wave operation. Compared to previous results this comes down to a 30% reduction of the threshold current and a maximum output power which is increased by more than a factor of 10.

articleTitle: CMOS compatible contacts and etching for InP-on-silicon active devices
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present CMOS compatible dry etching and nonalloyed ohmic contacts on InP dice on silicon. These developments are validated through the demonstration of a continuous wave Ill-V/Si laser with etched facets and gold free contacts.

articleTitle: Monolithic Ge/Si avalanche photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate mesa-type and waveguide-type Ge/Si avalanche photodiodes both with high performances. The gain-bandwidth product was measured as high as 340 GHz and the receiver sensitivity was -28 dBm and -30.4 dBm for mesa-and waveguide-type devices, respectively.

articleTitle: Equivalent circuit model of a Ge/Si avalanche photodiode
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: An equivalent circuit model for a separate-absorption-charge-multiplication Ge/Si avalanche photodiode is presented. The current dependence of the resonance frequency scales with square root of current, as expected.

articleTitle: CMOS compatible silicon etched V-grooves integrated with a SOI fiber coupling technique for enhancing fiber-to-chip alignment
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Integration of a polarization insensitive inverted taper-based fiber coupling structure with silicon etched V-grooves is demonstrated in CMOS silicon photonics. Coupling loss of 7.5 dB are measured at lambda=1.55 mum. A spectrum broader than 70 nm is observed.

articleTitle: Stress-induced χ(2) in silicon — Comparison between theoretical and experimental values
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We provide a new theoretical estimation of stress-induced chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> in silicon and highlight the fact that there exists a large difference between theoretical and experimentally measured values. Possible reasons for this discrepancy are discussed.

articleTitle: 50 Gbit/s wavelength division multiplexing using silicon microring modulators
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate 50 Gbit/s modulation using four silicon microring modulators within a footprint of 500 mum<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. This is the highest total modulation capacity shown in silicon using compact micro-ring modulators.

articleTitle: An optically-pumped silicon evanescent microring resonator laser
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate an optically-pumped hybrid silicon evanescent microring laser fabricated by a self-aligned process. Low threshold carrier densities (<2.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> cm-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) are measured for both 15 and 25 μm diameter devices. Lasing up to 50 °C is achieved with 0.1 nm/°C wavelength red shift rate.

articleTitle: Spectral selective mid-infrared detector on a silicon platform
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report the design, fabrication, and characterization of spectral selective mid-infrared PbTe photodetector pixels monolithically integrated on a silicon platform. We demonstrate spectral selectivity with a peak responsivity of 65.4 V/W.

articleTitle: European HELIOS project: Silicon photonic photodetector integration
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report recent experimental results of two kinds of photodetectors developed in the framework of the European project HELIOS: InAlAs-InGaAs metal-semiconductor-metal photodetectors and germanium photodetectors.

articleTitle: InP/InGaAs photodetector on SOI circuitry
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present the design, fabrication and characterization of an InP-based membrane photodetector on an SOI wafer containing a Si-wiring photonic circuit. Measured detector responsivity and 3 dB bandwidth are 0.45 A/W and 33 GHz, respectively. The photonic device fabrication is compatible with wafer scale processing steps, guaranteeing compatibility towards future generation electronic IC processing.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic interconnect with micrometer-scale devices
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a high-speed integrated optical link on a silicon chip using low-power silicon microresonator electro-optic modulators and low-capacitance germanium photodetectors. Integrating compact devices to provide multiple functions is essential for building scalable optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Si/Ge separated absorption charge multiplication avalanche photodetector with low dark current
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report a Ge/Si APD with a gain of 8.8 when biased at 90% of breakdown voltage operating at 1310nm. The dark current density is less than 82 uA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at biases up to −20 V.

articleTitle: Low loss dispersion engineered photonic crystal waveguides for optical delay lines
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate slow light photonic crystal waveguides with low dispersion and propagation loss. We then use this to create a distortion-less 1 byte delay for 25ps pulses.

articleTitle: Femtosecond index dynamics in silicon wire waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We studied ultrafast optical dynamics in silicon wire waveguides operating at 1.55 mum by employing a heterodyne pump-probe method with 240-fs temporal resolution. From measurement results, nonlinear properties were determined.

articleTitle: Silicon waveguide optical circulator employing nonreciprocal phase shift
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: This paper proposes an optical circulator employing a nonreciprocal phase shift with a silicon waveguide. Two types of optical circulator are investigated, a perfectly circulating 4-port optical circulator and a 3-port optical circulator.

articleTitle: Low-temperature germanium ultra-high vacuum chemical vapor deposition for back-end photonic integration
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Polycrystalline germanium (poly-Ge) grown on amorphous Si (a-Si) by ultra-high vacuum chemical vapor deposition (UHVCVD) over oxide barriers at low temperatures (Tles450degC) exhibits a larger grain size and lower defect density than the as-grown poly-Ge next to the oxide barriers. Poly-Ge as deposited at 450degC is p-type, but the introduction of PH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> during Ge deposition gives n-type poly-Ge with n = 2.1times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. The possible defect reduction and range of doping make poly-Ge a strong candidate for application to CMOS-compatible back-end photonic devices.

articleTitle: Rib waveguide to strip waveguide mode converter using local oxidation of silicon (LOCOS)
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A mode converter that goes from a rib waveguide to a strip waveguide has been demonstrated. The mode converter contains a 3-D taper fabricated using LOCOS. The demonstrated losses are 0.34 dB per coupler.

articleTitle: Improvement of threshold and mode selectivity of a microdisk laser by engineering its coupling to an external passive cavity
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: An optimization of coupling conditions between microdisk based lasers and waveguides is presented using an analytical model. Adding an external passive cavity can increase mode selectivity and get a single, unidirectional and tunable output waveguide.

articleTitle: Athermal SOI ring resonators by overlaying a polymer cladding on narrowed waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Athermal silicon ring resonators are experimentally demonstrated by overlaying a polymer cladding on narrowed silicon wires. The wavelength temperature dependence of the silicon ring resonator is reduced from 54.2 pm/degC to -4.9 pm/degC.

articleTitle: A serial-cascaded double-microring-based silicon photonic circuit for high-speed on-chip clock-recovery applications
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We fabricate a silicon microring-based photonic circuit comprising a passive NRZ-to-PRZ signal-format converter and a serial-cascaded modulator for clock-recovery applications. We demonstrate on the same chip 5-Gbit/s format conversion and 5-GHz sampling with 64-ps-width pulses.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic wire evanescent field sensors: From sensor to biochip array
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Silicon photonic wire waveguides have a remarkably high response to surface molecular binding. Evanescent field waveguide sensors based on silicon can be interrogated using Mach-Zehnder interferometers, ring resonators, or by probing surface gratings in a reflection geometry. This paper compares these approaches from a theoretical viewpoint and through recent experimental results, with the goal of defining a path from our existing individual sensors to practical biosensor array chips.

articleTitle: A silicon-based electrical source for surface plasmon polaritons
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: This work demonstrates the fabrication of a silicon-based electrical source for surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs) at low temperatures using silicon nanocrystal doped alumina within a metal-insulator-metal (MIM) waveguide geometry. The fabrication method uses established microtechnology processes that are compatible with backend CMOS technology. The fabricated device suggests a route forward towards high density, active plasmonic circuits that are integrated with silicon microelectronics.

articleTitle: Optical gain from the direct gap transition of Ge-on-Si at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report direct band gap optical gain of tensile strained n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> epitaxial Ge-on-Si at room temperature, which confirms that band-engineered Ge-on-Si is a promising gain medium for monolithic optical amplifiers and lasers on Si.

articleTitle: A high power Ge n-i-p waveguide photodetector on silicon-on-insulator substrate
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate high current operation of an evanescently coupled Ge waveguide photodetector grown on top of a Si rib waveguide. A 7.4 mum times 500 mum photodetector was found to dissipate 1.003 W of power (125.49 mA at -8V).

articleTitle: High-speed RPCVD Ge waveguide photodetector
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report high-speed waveguide photodetectors with RPCVD-grown Ge on SOI. The device exhibits a 3 dB bandwidth of ~50 GHz, a responsivity of 0.8 A/W, and a low dark current of 35 nA at lambda ~ 1.55 mum.

articleTitle: A monolithic integration of Ge photodiodes with Si variable optical attenuators
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Ge p-i-n photodiodes integrated with Si variable optical attenuators exhibit low dark current of 60 nA and high responsivity of 0.85 A/W at -1 V. These Ge photodiodes have potential for monolithic integration with other Si photonic components.

articleTitle: Gain measurements of quantum well intermixed hybrid silicon evanescent lasers
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Using a single active material, we demonstrate hybrid silicon lasers having 4 different wavelengths spanning >100 nm. Measurements show that performance is similar for lasers operating at 1450, 1475, 1510, and 1560 nm.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator microring resonator for ultra dense WDM applications
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate design, fabrication and measurement of silicon-on-insulator microring resonators suitable for ultra dense WDM applications with a channel spacing of 0.1 nm. Considerations about applying it to practical use are also discussed.

articleTitle: Modification of spontaneous emission rates in shallow ridge 8.3 nm erbium doped silica slot waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We show that conventional expressions for spontaneous emission into waveguide modes correctly predict broadband (non-resonant) Purcell enhancement in slot waveguides. Time resolved photoluminescence measurements on Er-doped ultra-thin 8.3 nm slot channel waveguides corroborate this effect.

articleTitle: High-speed modulation of a compact silicon ring resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate high speed modulation based on a compact silicon ring resonator operating in depletion mode. Our device features an electrical small signal bandwidth of approximately 19 GHz, which is the fastest silicon ring resonator modulator reported to date.

articleTitle: Crystalline silicon nanomembrane stacking for large-area flexible photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Flexible photodetectors were demonstrated experimentally on large-area crystalline silicon nanomembranes (3 mm times 3 mm), based on wet transfer and metal-frame supported transfer processes. Very low dark current (a few nA) and linear photoresponses were demonstrated for both Si MSM and InP PIN photodiodes on flexible PET substrates.

articleTitle: Modifying the radiative quantum efficiency of erbium-doped glass in silicon slot waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We have modulated the radiative emission rate of Er In SI slot waveguides with Er-doped glass slots by varying the waveguide layer dimensions. The corresponding quantum efficiency of 1537-nm emission varies between 0.37 and 0.51.

articleTitle: SOI platform for high speed all optical wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: In this paper we present new design of an all-optical wavelength converter (AOWC) based on silicon-on-insulator platform. For that purpose we combine nonlinearities of semiconductor optical amplifiers (SOA) with high finesse Mach-Zehnder filters, available in SOI-technology.

articleTitle: Lasing of the III/V compound semiconductor Ga(NAsP) integrated lattice-matched to Si substrate
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Ga(NAsP) multi quantum well heterostructures were grown pseudomorphically on exactly oriented (001) silicon substrates without the formation of misfit dislocations. Optical pumped lasing operation was observed at temperatures up to 125 K.

articleTitle: Refractive index buffer enhanced out-of-plane coupling in silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A refractive index buffer enhanced grating coupler in Silicon-on-insulator (SOI) was demonstrated. By a PMMA cladding layer, the grating coupler with the efficiency of 44% and 3-dB bandwidth of > 40 nm was obtained.

articleTitle: Large bandwidth continuously tunable delay using silicon microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a distortion free tunable delays as long as 72 ps with a 10 GHz bandwidth using thermally tuned silicon microring resonators. The device is compact measuring only 30 mum wide by 250 mum long.

articleTitle: Center wavelength uniformity of shallow-etched silicon photonic wire AWG
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We have fabricated a WDM device consisting of two or three shallow-etched AWGs on 5-inch SOI wafer. The center wavelength difference between the closely located AWGs was smaller than 1 nm. Meanwhile, the center wavelength deviation over the whole wafer was larger than 5 nm.

articleTitle: Sub-micron Si waveguide design for polarization independent Mach-Zehnder filter
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report the design for the polarization independent Mach-Zehnder interferometer wavelength filter using sub-micron Si waveguide. The same waveguide cross sections can be used for the directional coupler and phase shifter. A high refractive index upper cladding structure enables an easy integration of the filter device and spot size converter. Optimized ridge waveguide also shows polarization independence.

articleTitle: Processing and properties of ytterbium-erbium silicate thin film gain media
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The structural and photoluminescence properties of ytterbium-erbium silicate thin films have been investigated. The films were fabricated by RF-magnetron co-sputtering of Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, Yb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> on c-Si and subsequent annealing in N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> or O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> atmosphere.

articleTitle: Broadband hitless silicon electro-optic switch for optical networkson-chip
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report the demonstration of a broadband (60 GHz) hitless switch electrically driven by PIN diodes surrounding two coupled resonant cavities. The topology used enables the switch operation without perturbing adjacent channels in a WDM system.

articleTitle: A high speed Mach-Zehnder silicon evanescent modulator using capacitively loaded traveling wave electrode
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a traveling-wave Mach-Zehnder silicon evanescent modulator that implements a slotline design for the electrodes. The device has a modulation efficiency of 1.6 V-mm and modulation bandwidth of 20 GHz.

articleTitle: WDM addressed SOI ring resonator biosensor array
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report a SOI ring resonator biosensor array with 1 reference ring and 4 sensing rings, using WDM as the addressing scheme. On-chip referencing and temperature shift cancellation are demonstrated, and the differential signal shows a low temperature sensitivity of ~plusmn0.8 pm/degC.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible waveguiding platform on bulk silicon
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a bulk silicon alternative to the conventional silicon-on-insulator photonics platform. We show waveguide losses of 10 dB/cm with a technique that can be implemented on the front-end of a typical CMOS fabrication line.

articleTitle: Influence of CARS process in silicon Raman laser
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We investigated the coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) process in silicon Raman laser through a two-model approach. Significant output enhancement and threshold reduction could be obtained simultaneously with a phase-matched silicon waveguide cavity. End-facet reflectivity analysis is also explored to obtain output maximization configuration.

articleTitle: Bipolar injection in nanocrystalline-Si LEDs with low turn-on voltages and high power efficiency
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Bipolar (electrons and holes) charge injection, the onset voltages of electroluminescence as low as 1.4 V, and power efficiency of around 0.2% are demonstrated in thin nanocrystalline-Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> multilayer LEDs grown by plasma-enhanced CVD.

articleTitle: Graphene and carbon nanotube photonics
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Graphene and carbon nanotube based photonic devices, including light emitters and high bandwidth photodetectors are demonstrated. The potential of these truly nanometer scale, 2-dimensional (graphene) and quasi 1-dimensional (nanotube) carbon materials in photonics are discussed.

articleTitle: Broadband CARS wavelength conversion in silicon
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Broadband coherent antistokes Raman scattering (CARS) is observed experimentally in silicon, facilitated by self-phase modulation induced spectral broadening of the pump. Numerical modeling reveals the strong influence of free carrier dynamics on the CARS process.

articleTitle: Differential gain at 1.54 μm in Er-doped silicon nitride coupled to photonic crystal cavity
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Light emission at 1.54 mum from Er-doped amorphous silicon nitride layer coupled to high quality factor photonic crystal resonators is studied. Resonances exhibit line-width narrowing with pump power, signifying differential gain in the material.

articleTitle: Composite superprism demultiplexer
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A superprism design is proposed whereby simultaneous wavelength separation and diffraction compensation in the slab region considerably shrinks the area required when compared to the preconditioned superprism design. All-parallel, diffraction-limited outputs obviate the focusing optics.

articleTitle: Efficient Si-on-Ge tandem solar cell
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We propose and simulate a thin-film crystalline solar photovoltaic cell comprised of two junctions - one in the Si top layer and the other in the Ge bottom layer. Assuming an anti-reflection coating on the front surface, we have shown that optimal solar cells favor a thin Si layer and a thicker Ge layer. For AM1.5G solar irradiance, we predict efficiency of ~20 % for a cell in which the Si film thickness is 7 mum and the Ge film thickness is 91 mum.

articleTitle: Enhanced light emission from Erbium doped silicon photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We use photonic crystal nanocavities to enhance the light emission for Erbium implanted silicon. This is a promising route for the realization of a silicon light source.

articleTitle: Intense photoluminescence from Eu-doped silicon-rich silicon oxide films prepared by electron beam evaporation
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Eu-doped silicon-rich silicon oxide (SRSO) films on P (100) Si substrate were deposited by electron beam evaporation (EBE). The effect of annealing procedure on the photoluminescence (PL) has been investigated in detail. Experimental results show that after 1100°C annealing at non-reductive atmosphere, the films are revealed to yield an intense broad band yellow light emission. PL spectra of the broad yellow band are centered at about 530 nm which agrees with 4f<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>5d-4f<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>(<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7/2</inf>) transition of divalent europium ions (Eu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>). And the existence of Eu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> has been further confirmed by XPS measurement results.

articleTitle: Integration of an Er doped silicon-rich-silicon nitride (SRSN) microdisk with SU-8 waveguide for on-chip, Si based light source
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Er doped planar type SRSN microdisks were integrated with polymer waveguides on a same chip with various gaps. FDTD simulation showed well confined modes in the disk. Experimental transmission spectrum and Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> emission were observed.

articleTitle: Group IV photonics meets plasmonics
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Group IV photonics has seen tremendous progress in the development of high performance light sources, waveguides, modulators, and detectors. Plasmonics is an exploding new field of science and technology in which the flow of light can be molded at the nanoscale using metallic nanostructures. This newly found ability is rapidly impacting every facet of optics and photonics and is enabling a myriad of exciting new technologies. As plasmonic devices can be fabricated using CMOS compatible nanofabrication techniques, it is worth exploring opportunities at the interface between group IV photonics and plasmonics. I will discuss recent progress in the development of hybrid devices that exploit the best of each technology and provide my personal assessment of the limitations and most exciting future opportunities for the field.

articleTitle: Efficient luminescence in highly tensile-strained germanium
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Up to 2.3% biaxial tensile-strained Ge layers have been grown on InGaAs/GaAs buffer layers. A dramatic increase in low temperature photoluminescence intensity for >2% strained Ge confirms the existence of a direct band gap Ge.

articleTitle: Novel nonreciprocal waveguide grating based on SOI: Characteristics and application
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The nonreciprocal filtering characteristics of magnetooptic waveguide grating are analyzed. The grating is obtained by bonding magnetooptic layer on SOI. A zero leakage-loss passive optical combiner based on the waveguide grating is proposed.

articleTitle: Er3+ excitation and up-conversion processes in Y2−xErxSi2O7 films for planar optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Structural and optical properties of Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> thin films have been studied. For higher Er content mechanisms related to Er-Er interactions increase optical efficiency. Moreover the influence of up-conversion has been estimated.

articleTitle: A very wide stopband (≈300nm) optical filter based on a photonic crystal vertical directional coupler
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present a new vertical directional coupler based on the coupling between a polymer waveguide and a photonic crystal waveguide with a very wide stopband.

articleTitle: Tensile-strain and n-type doping of germanium-on-insulator : Towards a Ge laser
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Using a 30 band k.p formalism, we calculate the band structure and the optical gain of tensilely-strained germanium. We show that the room temperature emission of germanium-on-insulator can be significantly enhanced by n-doping of germanium.

articleTitle: Quantum-confined Stark effect electro-absorption modulators for CMOS compatible photonics
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: A design for a quantum-confined Stark effect electro-absorption modulator is described. We use k. p and effective-mass modelling methods to optimise the quantum well dimensions, and employ strain engineering to target 1.3-µm light.

articleTitle: Scattering loss of multi-slot silicon light emission device: Theory and experiment
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Ever since slot waveguide was first proposed, its unique photon confinement characteristic has attracted a lot of interest. Its applications in several areas such as silicon light emission device, nonlinear optical device, and optical bio detection have been proposed and experimentally verified. Different merit functions for device design have also been proposed for some specific applications. This paper presents results from theoretical and experimental studies performed on horizontal multi-slot waveguides made of alternating nm-thick Si and SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> layers. The surface roughness of an interface is mathematically described by two parameters: the RMS roughness and the correlation length. Using a statistical approach in solving Maxwell's equation, the scattering loss of multi-slot waveguides for TE and TM polarization is calculated. A top-scattering method is used to experimentally measure the propagation loss of 2D planar waveguides, while light is coupled into the waveguide via a prism coupler. The experimental results agree well with our theoretical predictions. The optical gain for TM polarization in multi-slot waveguides, using realistic parameters, is also calculated. The result shows that optical gain is much higher than the additional scattering loss due to the multiple interfaces.

articleTitle: Disorder limits in passive and amplifying slow light waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present a simulation approach to estimate the effect of disorder induced backscattering in slow light photonic crystal line-defect waveguides. The backscattering leads to localization and thus limits the maximal length of such waveguides. Loss in passive waveguides in the localization regime reduces ripples in spectral transmission and group delay whereas gain increases these resonant multiple scattering effects.

articleTitle: Low power optic switch using SOI-nanowires
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: An optic switch of SOI-nanowires with a very low power consumption of less than 1 mW is presented. The nanowires are placed on freestanding electrostatically deflectable SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-membranes to tune them thermo-optically and elasto-optically.

articleTitle: Q-factor tuning in all-active whispering-gallery mode resonators with Si-nc
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Q-factor tuning in stress-engineered microresonators is presented. Bent-edge microdisks (mu-kylix), where highest Q's are 60 nm blue-shifted with respect to flat disks, are used to probe Purcell enhancement of Si-nc emission rate in a wide spectral range.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of horizontal air-slot microdisk resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Pedestal-type microdisk resonators with SiN disks and SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> slots are fabricated. By selective etching, air-slots for maximum light confinement could be obtained. Resonant modes for both oxide- and air slots were measured using tapered fiber coupling.

articleTitle: Design of a two-stage Si pumped Er:SiO2 laser based on concentric microdisks
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We propose a two-stage lasing device in which an electroluminescent Si nanocrystal (Si-nc) disk optically pumps a concentric Er:SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> toroid. We also present fabrication and characterization of an Er:SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> microdisk and demonstrate coupling of Si-nc emission to a concentric SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> ring.

articleTitle: Low-dark-current pin photodiodes using as-grown Ge with an i-Si insertion layer: Mechanism of dark current suppression
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Low dark current of ~10 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> by inserting i-Si in as-grown Ge pin photodiodes is dominated by the carrier generation in wider-gap i-Si. This property is useful for photodiode applications of defective Ge prepared at low temperatures.

articleTitle: InP-based 2D photonic crystal lasers heterogeneously integrated and coupled to SOI wires
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The fabrication of 2D InP-based photonic crystal lasers accurately aligned with SOI wire waveguides will be presented. Low threshold pulsed lasing operation is achieved by pumping via the SOI waveguide.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional photonic components based on optically active group IV membranes
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Optically active microtubes are fabricated by high temperature annealing of Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> rolled-up membranes. Spontaneous emission from Si nanostructures dispersed in microtubes is investigated by photoluminescence spectroscopy. Waveguiding along the axis of Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> tubes is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Extremely low power consumption thermo-optic switches using silica-based PLCs
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: This paper reviews recent progress on low power consumption thermo-optic switches using silica-based planar lightwave circuits. These switches are indispensable for monolithically integrated PLC devices that include many thermo-optic switches.

articleTitle: Luminescence properties of ErxY2−xSiO5 thin film prepared by sol-gel method
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> (x=0.1~2) crystalline thin films with the same structure of Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystal are demonstrated. Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> films with various x values were prepared by the sol-gel method. Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> films show a highly-ordered crystalline structure still for x~0.1. With decreasing the Er content, the photoluminescence intensity was almost constant till x~0.5, and then increased strongly for x below 0.5. The PL decay time also strongly depends on x value. With decreasing x, the decay time becomes longer and becomes 500 us at x=0.1. The decay time quenching is in agreement with PL efficiency. Here we discuss the decay time quenching in Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystalline system.

articleTitle: Group IV crystalline nanomembranes: Materials, technology, and potential applications
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Crystalline nanomembranes of Group IV elements offer a new perspective on potential photonic and optoelectronic structures, including flexible photodetectors, photonic crystals, wave guides, light sources, and oscillators.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Kerr switching in a silicon waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a Kerr switch based on nonlinear polarization rotation induced by cross-phase modulation in a silicon strip waveguide. Our numerical simulations agree with the experimental measurements and reveal the potential of sub-picosecond switching.

articleTitle: Total gain of silicon Raman amplifiers: Scaling with group velocity in slow-light waveguides
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The maximum total gain in slow-light silicon Raman amplifiers is obtained when arranging for the largest-possible Stokes slow-down factor and a pump-power-dependent optimal pump slow-down factor.

articleTitle: Structural and light-emission properties of bulk Germanium islands grown on Silicon using Molecular Beam Epitaxy
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report on the optoelectronic properties of bulk Germanium islands formed on Silicon by Molecular Beam Epitaxy. More specifically, we will discuss the role of strains and doping in favoring efficient light-emission at telecommunication wavelengths.

articleTitle: Athermal wavelength property of Si-slot ring resonator embedded with benzocyclobutene
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: An athermal silicon-slot-waveguide ring resonator embedded with benzocyclobutene (BCB), which is low-k material for electronics, was proposed and demonstrated. The temperature dependence of the drop wavelengths as small as -0.6 pm/K was achieved.

articleTitle: Enhancement of two-photon excited fluorescence from quantum dots on SiN photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The two-photon excited fluorescence from CdSe/ZnS quantum dots on the surface of a two-dimensional SiN photonic crystal was investigated. With photonic crystal, the enhancement and the blue shift of two-photon excited fluorescence was observed.

articleTitle: Approach to modify crystalline structures of Er2SiO5 by pulsed laser deposition
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystal shows strong and sharp Er-related PL emissions at room temperature. It is expected as a basic material of waveguide amplifiers in silicon photonics. Recently we have proposed Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystal preparation by Pulsed Laser Deposition (PLD) method for device applications. In this paper we introduce PLD approach to modify crystalline structures of Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystal and the related materials. Here we focus on formation of Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>/Si stacked structure toward light emitting devices (LEDs) and formation of Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> systems to reduce upconversion effectively.

articleTitle: Enhanced Er3+ luminescence of Er silicate through Y and Yb co-doping
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Enhanced Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> luminescence of Er silicate through Y and Yb co-doping were observed in different pump wavelengths of 654 nm and 980 nm, respectively, and corresponding excited mechanism was discussed.

articleTitle: Si nanocluster — Er interaction distance: The role of Er-Er energy migration
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The interaction distance between Si nanoluster and Er is investigated using multilayers. We find that the effective sensitization distance can be more than twice the cluster-Er interaction distance due to Er-Er energy transfer.

articleTitle: Optical gain and transient nonlinearities in Ge quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Ultrafast carrier dynamics of Ge/SiGe quantum wells grown on a Si substrate are investigated using pump-probe spectroscopy. Optical gain and population inversion are obtained on a femtosecond time scale. A microscopic theory supports the results.

articleTitle: Sensitization of the 1.54μm Er emission in amorphous silicon nitride films
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We report on the fabrication, structural and optical properties of Er doped amorphous silicon nitride. The effect of excess Si on the sensitization of the 1.54 μm Er emission will be discussed.

articleTitle: Photo-response of Si-rich oxynitride film
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Negative photo-conductivity, super linear variation of short circuit current with incident light power, and IR absorption have been observed in Si-rich oxynitride film containing silicon nanocrystals and the mechanism was discussed.

articleTitle: All-optical 3R regeneration in silicon photonic wires though cross-phase modulation and free-carrier dispersion
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We propose an all-optical 3R regeneration scheme utilizing silicon-wire nonlinear photonics including cross-phase modulation and free-carrier dispersion. From the simulation results, the Q-factor of 10-Gb/s RZ signals can be improved with a suitable free-carrier lifetime.

articleTitle: Ultracompact, low-power and ultrafast optical switching based on silicon photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon optical switch that can reroute optical signals within a switching time of just 3 ps. The switch is based on photonic crystal waveguides in a directional coupler geometry. The dispersion of the device has been engineered to provide slow-light enhancement, which allows the switching length of the device to be just 5 mum. The 3 ps switching time is demonstrated using free-carriers in the silicon generated by the absorption of a femtosecond laser pulse.

articleTitle: Effects of slot geometry on the slot-mode overlap and Q-factors of horizontal slot microdisk resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Effects of slot geometry on the slot-mode overlap and Q-factors of horizontal slot microdisk resonators are investigated by FDTD method. Optimum parameters are suggested, with particular emphasis on bio applications.

articleTitle: High speed optical modulation in Ge quantum wells using quantum confined stark effect
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We designed the coplanar high-speed modulator with Ge/SiGe quantum wells, and demonstrated 25 GHz of modulation with 3.125 GHz of eye diagram using quantum-confined Stark effect.

articleTitle: Electro-optic modulation in hybrid SOI and polymer slotted resonant photonic crystal heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: We present experimental evidence of electro-optic modulation in slotted photonic crystal heterostructure waveguides based on silicon-on-insulator substrates covered and infiltrated with nonlinear optical polymer material.

articleTitle: Carrier thermalization in Ge quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Ultrafast carrier relaxation of Ge/SiGe quantum wells grown on a Si substrate are investigated using pump-probe spectroscopy. A nonthermal carrier distribution is observed. The corresponding inter- and intra-valley scattering times are deduced.

articleTitle: Committee
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members.

articleTitle: Author index
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: 2009 6th IEEE International Conference on Group IV Photonics
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: photonic integration technology; photodetectors; optical resonators and photonic crystals; rare earth doped materials; plasmonics and optomechanics; optical sensors and filters; nonlinear silicon photonics; photonic membranes; III-V on silicon devices; optical switching and modulation; and germanium gain and emission.
